learningObjective: Identify sources of non-determinism in GPU-based ML training/inference and which knobs (deterministic algorithms flag, atomic-free kernels, seed control) address them.

canonicalClaims.claim: Cross-block atomicAdd on floats and non-deterministic cuDNN algorithm selection are two of the main GPU non-determinism sources; PyTorch's deterministic-algorithms flag and cudnn.deterministic address the latter but do not guarantee cross-architecture bit-identity.
conditions: Determinism flags actually set and seeds fixed.
nonImplications: Does not imply determinism is free of performance cost.

misconceptions.whyWrong: Different hardware runs different code paths; bit-identity is not a guarantee.

misconceptions.claim: Fixing RNG seeds is sufficient for determinism.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Op-level non-determinism (atomics, cuDNN choice) is orthogonal to RNG seeds.

misconceptions.claim: atomicAdd of floats is deterministic under a fixed CUDA driver version.
misconceptions.whyWrong: CUDA does not order concurrent atomics; results depend on scheduling.

misconceptions.claim: cuDNN always picks the same algorithm given the same input shapes.
misconceptions.whyWrong: In benchmark mode cuDNN times multiple algorithms and picks the fastest per run, which may vary.
